newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China steel firm aims to issue 200 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China steel firm aims to issue 200 mln A shares.

text.p: China's Shaogang Songshan Co Ltd has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an initial public offering of 200 million domestic A shares in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

If the issue goes ahead, the steel producer would use the funds raised to finance a series of steel-rolling technology upgrades, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
A lead underwriter has yet to be chosen for the planned offer, he said.
Based in Shaoguan in Guangdong province, the company projects steel output at 1.10 million tonnes in 1997 against 950,000 last year, the official said.
The firm estimated its 1996 net earnings at more than 100 million yuan, roughly equalling its 1995 level, he said, but gave no further details.
